fact_text: The KSE-100 closed 2024 near 115,000 points, a finish the analyst says could have been stronger.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'What's NEXT for Pakistan Stock Market in 2025?' (YouTube, 2024-12-31)

fact_text: Falling inflation and a surplus current account in 2024 were key reasons the KSE-100 gained that year, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'What's NEXT for Pakistan Stock Market in 2025?' (YouTube, 2024-12-31)

fact_text: Rupee stability after the IMF programme, with imports and demand curbed, kept the dollar steady and supported the market, the analyst says.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'What's NEXT for Pakistan Stock Market in 2025?' (YouTube, 2024-12-31)

fact_text: Pakistan's government announced a Reko Diq stake sale for $540 million, with OGDC and PPL among the holders involved.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'What's NEXT for Pakistan Stock Market in 2025?' (YouTube, 2024-12-31)

fact_text: OGDC and PPL hold about 8.33% of Reko Diq, and the cabinet announced that 5% of that holding is for sale.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'What's NEXT for Pakistan Stock Market in 2025?' (YouTube, 2024-12-31)

fact_text: The analyst recalls a Reko Diq and Barrick Gold valuation of about $38 billion from around 2022, which he says dwarfs the size of the stake sale.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'What's NEXT for Pakistan Stock Market in 2025?' (YouTube, 2024-12-31)

fact_text: The Reko Diq deposit holds gold, copper, cobalt and about 25 other metals, which the analyst says must be extracted.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'What's NEXT for Pakistan Stock Market in 2025?' (YouTube, 2024-12-31)

fact_text: Only time will show when Saudi Arabia takes part in the Reko Diq project, the analyst says.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'What's NEXT for Pakistan Stock Market in 2025?' (YouTube, 2024-12-31)

fact_text: The analyst thinks Reko Diq's gold, copper and other exports may pass through a terminal, possibly that of Pakistan International Bulk Terminal.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'What's NEXT for Pakistan Stock Market in 2025?' (YouTube, 2024-12-31)

fact_text: The analyst says OGDC and PPL's share of Reko Diq proceeds will not change their accounts much for the time being.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'What's NEXT for Pakistan Stock Market in 2025?' (YouTube, 2024-12-31)

fact_text: Biafo Industries is an old company whose products are used in drilling and excavation work, which the analyst links to the Reko Diq project.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'What's NEXT for Pakistan Stock Market in 2025?' (YouTube, 2024-12-31)

fact_text: International Industries makes spiral pipes, and the analyst names it among companies linked to the Reko Diq theme.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'What's NEXT for Pakistan Stock Market in 2025?' (YouTube, 2024-12-31)

fact_text: The analyst calls Mughal Steel the best large long-steel (rebar) player in Pakistan, with strong income statement numbers and copper ingots exported to China.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'What's NEXT for Pakistan Stock Market in 2025?' (YouTube, 2024-12-31)

fact_text: The analyst names International Steels as the strongest flat-steel player in cold-rolled and galvanised products.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'What's NEXT for Pakistan Stock Market in 2025?' (YouTube, 2024-12-31)

fact_text: If the FATA and PATA steel subsidy ends, large steel makers may gain market share, the analyst says.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'What's NEXT for Pakistan Stock Market in 2025?' (YouTube, 2024-12-31)

fact_text: Cold-rolled and hot-rolled flat steel could improve in early 2025 as construction demand picks up, the analyst expects.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'What's NEXT for Pakistan Stock Market in 2025?' (YouTube, 2024-12-31)

fact_text: The analyst says the market and Reko Diq could rally strongly if political conditions normalise over the following three to four months.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'What's NEXT for Pakistan Stock Market in 2025?' (YouTube, 2024-12-31)
